verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page lists "Multivariate and A/B Testing" as a plan feature, and its help docs say open and click rates measure engagement with subject lines and email content. Together these suggest variant testing backed by real engagement metrics. However, the evidence is only a feature-list line, with no documentation of how tests are set up or how a winner is chosen. Missing for 10: documented subject-line vs. content variant setup, automatic winner selection based on engagement (opens/clicks/revenue), test-size and duration controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
